posts.caption:
We challenge repetition. We break conventions.

Our manifesto:

[01] DESTRUCTION OF THE PREDICTABLE.
Rejecting commercial club formulas, VIP divisions, and playlist conformity.

[02] ACOUSTIC RIGIDITY & HYPNOTIC CONTINUITY.
Curating fast, dark, groove-laden rhythms with absolute 25 Hz sub-bass integrity.

[03] A RADICAL DANCEFLOOR SANCTUARY.
A community built on bodily autonomy, radical safety, mutual respect, and pure freedom.

[04] ZERO COMPROMISE. NO NOSTALGIA.
Forward-leaning electronic sound. Leave your ego outside the door.

This is our foundation.

#khaosmanifesto #undergroundculture #technocollective #mauritiuselectronic #noharassment #saferspace #puretechno

posts.caption:
The KHAOS Dancefloor Code:

[01] RADICAL INCLUSIVITY & AUTONOMY
A sanctuary for all identities, backgrounds, and bodies. Wear what you want. Be who you are.

[02] ZERO TOLERANCE FOR HARASSMENT
Any racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, or non-consensual behavior results in immediate permanent ban.

[03] NO PHONES ON THE DANCEFLOOR
Protect the sanctuary. Cameras and flash are strictly prohibited. Be present in the sound.

[04] LEAVE YOUR EGO AT THE DOOR
No VIP tables. No bottle service. No backstage status. We exist as one before the sound system.

Respect the space. Respect each other.

#dancefloorcode #saferspace #inclusiverave #technocommunity #nopartyphotos #khaosvalues
